Introduction

Welcome! Welcome to city 17- sorry! wrong wiki. Welcome to Characters page! A page dedicated to all characters in this mod.
The formula for this page is somewhat like this: First, there are the general statistics, then, the storyline of any given character is a summary of all of the logs and other scraps of lore present IN the mod, no fanon nor answers from Wesley from outside of the mod included.

Agent Geoffrey

Full Name: Geoffrey Samuel Smith
Occupation: High Commander and Agent of the Emperor
Status: Deceased, killed either by a coil-head or infected with BIO-HXNV7 on Asteroid-13
Marital Status: Married to Madeline Smith (also deceased, blown up with Calist)
Children: more than one (all also blown up with Calist)
Age: Middle-aged
Voice Actor: Audio Knight, creator of Starlancer Moons
Place of birth: Unknown
Place of death: 57 Asteroid-13
Disclaimer: Geoffrey's storyline is presented backwards in the game, but I have flipped it here for the sake of logic!
Geoffrey's Storyline:
We "first" hear of Agent Geoffrey in his first log on Calist, where he and the Council Of Rule (aka God knows who, thanks for clarifying anything, Wesley, no, actually we know one member, Michael Dunton, more on him later.), are 4 weeks into a debate about the usage of bio-weapons.
The Council is very much against any use of the bio-weapons, and Geoffrey has been trying his best to convince them otherwise, despite knowing what atrocities can bio-weapons cause, because he is somewhat supposed to represent the Emperor after all.
After finishing his first log, Geoffrey (possibly) writes a letter to his Wife, Madeline Smith, before leaving Calist and heading to Polarus for the final meeting with the Emperor.
On Polarus, despite his best efforts to explain how the council is "very adamant about not allowing any bioweapons to be used or studied" to the Emperor, it was all in vain, as the Emperor ignored his reasoning, and instead, told Geoffrey to give the order for the Triton Military to nuke Calist.
He gave the order, "in the name of the Emperor", knowing what this incident will bring about.
After being assured that his family will get sent off to Trite (Editor Zenny here, uhh, spoiler alert: They went fucking nowhere and got blown up with Calist), he ends his log, and heads off to March, where he is tasked with assembling a team to research the moon of Cosmocos, including Captain Donahue and more notably, at the time, Lieutenant Commander Cunningham.
